cells.gaps: Three of 22 councils have MOPTAX 2.0 (December 2025), which is the system installed, not councils said to be billing from it; outside Freetown, Kenema is called a pilot in May 2026 and Makeni a deployment, and Bo and Koidu are a procurement. The rows disagree on where the record is held: the May 2026 notice says the system is integrated with the central monitoring system, the 2025 progress report says that integration is still expected in 2026.
cells.note: Only Freetown, the capital, is shown billing from a register; outside it the system is a pilot in Kenema and installed in Makeni. Stage 3 needs it past its pilot and in use in a council outside the capital.
